paper_title: Constraints on axionlike particles from a combined analysis of three flaring $\textit{Fermi}$ flat-spectrum radio quasars
notes: ALP-photon coupling constraint from gamma-ray observations of three flaring FSRQs using blazar jets as mixing region. Excludes ma ~5-200 neV with g_agamma >~ 5e-12 GeV^-1 at 95% CL. Numerical exclusion contours are shown in Figs 7-9 but only summary bounds are available in text; data points approximate the rectangular exclusion region. Not a DM haloscope, so no DM density assumed. Best-fit point (not exclusion): ma=100.8 neV, g=4.64e-12 GeV^-1. | Vision: Boundary traced from white contour (95% CL) in image 8 upper panel. Excluded region is above/left of contour. Minimum sensitivity around m_a~15 neV, g~4.6e-12 GeV^-1, rising sharply above ~200 neV. | CV calibration unavailable (fit failed), used LLM axes | Calibration: No calibration needed (spot-check verify/stage2 raw_ratio=0.80 snapped to identity)
